# N1: Review notes, reviews

A check of the Reviews module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/1-reviews.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

Lane's review notes (5 Nov), reviews. The Reviews list says where each session stands; a review's agenda is one line per goal with nothing cut off; once a session is held, the review's own page leads with what was said (the old /summary page redirects there).

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.

## What it reports as wrong


**The Reviews list: state as shape and word, session date, last held, open actions, people**

- List: {rows.length} reviews listed at {w} (passes when `rows.length === 6`)
- List {w}: {r.name} state is "{r.state}" (shape {r.shape})
- List {w}: {r.name} has no session date ({JSON.stringify(r.facts)})
- List {w}: {r.name} has no open-actions count
- List {w}: {r.name} has {r.cut} clipped parts (passes when `r.cut === 0`)
- List {w}: weekly last held "{weekly?.facts['Last held']}", expected Thu 29 Oct (last week's session)
- List {w}: weekly's people are "{weekly?.people}"

**The agenda: one line per goal, nothing cut off, at every width**

- Agenda {w}: only {m.rows} rows (passes when `m.rows >= 10`)
- Agenda {w}: clipped {m.clipped.slice(0, 2).join('; ')} clamped {m.clamped.slice(0, 2).join(',')} outside {m.outside.slice(0, 2).join(',')}
- Agenda {w}: names squeezed: {m.squeezed.slice(0, 2).join('; ')}
- Agenda {w}: {m.shape} shapes, {m.words} words, {m.nums} numbers on {m.rows} rows
- Agenda {w}: rows carry more than status, name, number and gap ({m.extra[0]})
- Agenda {w}: {m.sideways}px sideways scroll (passes when `m.sideways <= 1`)
- Agenda {w}: a row's status, name and number are not on one line ({n(line)}px apart) (passes when `line <= 4`)

**The review page: a terse line, the healthy group folded with one action**

- Hero: the line under the name is "{m.line}" (passes when `m.line.length <= 60`)
